name: genesis-retina
content:
.TH GENESIS-RETINA 1 "October 2026" "Genesis 0.2.0" "Genesis Manual"
.SH NAME
genesis-retina \- Genesis vision capture process (V4L2 -> shared memory)
.SH SYNOPSIS
.B genesis-retina
.SH DESCRIPTION
.B genesis-retina
is Genesis's eye. It opens the V4L2 capture device named by
.I GENESIS_CAMERA
(default
.IR /dev/video0 ),
requests an uncompressed RGB24 640x480 format (falling back to the
camera's native uncompressed format, typically YUYV, if RGB3 is
unavailable), and streams captured frames into a POSIX shared memory
object named
.IR /genesis_retina
(visible at
.IR /dev/shm/genesis_retina )
for the cognitive mind to read.

.PP
The binary is built from
.I src/bin/retina.rs
and is normally launched and supervised by
.BR genesis-cli (1),
which is in turn launched by
.BR genesis (1)
or the
.BR genesis (1)
console script. Direct invocation is supported for diagnostics. The
retina is optional: if no camera is present the launcher continues
without it, and the mind's vision paths degrade rather than fail.

.SS Shared memory layout
Each frame is written as a 28-byte header followed by the raw pixel
data:
.IP \(bu 2
The header carries the frame's width, height, stride, pixel format
FourCC, and a seqlock sequence counter for consistent reads.
.IP \(bu 2
The pixel data follows immediately, sized as
.IR width \(mu height \(mu bytes-per-pixel .
.PP
Readers must use the seqlock protocol (read the sequence counter
before and after the frame; retry if it changed or is odd). Writing
is single-producer (the retina); reading is many-consumer (any
process that maps the object).
.PP
The shared memory object is
.IR shm_unlink 'd
on the next run's pre-creation step so a fresh object is always
published, and on clean shutdown (SIGINT/SIGTERM) the retina unlinks
it before exiting so a stale
.I /dev/shm/genesis_retina
does not linger after the eye closes.
.SH SIGNALS
.TP
.B SIGINT ", " SIGTERM
Set the exit flag; the capture loop notices, unlinks the shared
memory object, and exits cleanly.
.SH ENVIRONMENT
.TP
.B GENESIS_CAMERA
Path of the V4L2 capture device to open. Default
.IR /dev/video0 .
Set by the user; the launcher passes it through to the retina
process.
.SH FILES
.TP
.I /dev/shm/genesis_retina
The POSIX shared memory object holding the latest frame.
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/retina.log
Retina stdout/stderr (rotated at 5 MB by the launcher).
.TP
.IR $DATA_DIR/genesis_retina.pid
PID file written by the launcher so
.BR genesis " \fB--stop\fR"
can target this exact process.
.SH SEE ALSO
.BR genesis (1),
.BR genesis-cli (1),
.BR genesis-daemon (8),
.BR genesis-math (7),
.BR genesis-reasoning (7)
